description: LMEB dialogue-memory smoke fixture for embedding model representation and recall evaluation.

corpus.text: The team agreed that Python 3.12 is the primary runtime for Hippo memory core.
Antigravity agents interact with Hippo memory via standard Model Context Protocol over stdio.
In case of memory corruption, Spool WAL provides crash-safe tombstone replay.
User expressed preference for concise pull request descriptions with mermaid diagrams.
Surge HTTP proxy is used to capture external network traffic for debugging.
The memory gate strictly filters low-confidence candidates with dense semantic score below 0.32.
